defect: Strict-facing recovery required physical component clearance as a minimum positive directional projection. The independent final gate requires positive direction, not that extra projected distance. This falsely excluded a legal narrow pocket.
reproduction: A 2x2 group lies in a pocket whose x range is [5,5.5], between fixed obstacles with 0.3 mm clearance. Its right-facing output can face the downstream target when x<5.2. The old recovery required x<=4.9 and rejected the feasible pocket. The regression failed before the production change.
change: Replace clearance in facing-only split/capacity equations with a rounding margin derived from the existing 0.0001 mm emitted lattice and normalized direction components. Keep physical clearance in board/obstacle bounds, conservative bound rounding, exact positive-facing acceptance, all retries and incumbent preservation.

tests.native_floorplan_contracts: PASS; includes 16 narrow-pocket variants over axis swap, reflection, compact mode, feasible/backward-only target. Rejection must preserve the incumbent.

smaller_screens.change: Before solver correction, free bringup_rails at 160x153 plus power_som=t180
Corrected solver, free bringup_rails at 160x153 without forced power_som tag

limits: No smaller board accepted; these screens do not prove infeasibility. Current PCB bytes unchanged, so existing renders remain applicable, but no new full build/render qualification or full-suite rerun was performed for this code change. Concurrent diagnostic timings are not performance comparisons. A separable facing split remains incomplete; coupled directional/occupancy search is still a candidate for improvement.
